rules.explanation: This compares tournaments where both players were in the same field.
rules.counting: Better finish wins the shared start. Tied finishes count as ties. WD and DQ are excluded by default. Missed cuts count below made cuts.
rules.dataNote: Uses manual Phil Mickelson and Justin Thomas results before 2017 where available, then automatic results from 2017 onward.
